Gathering Klefki (Japanese: クレッフィ、集める , Collect) is the 573rd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 25th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Clemont awakens at the Team Flare Secret HQ.
Xerosic holds Clemont's Heliolisk hostage to force him to build a machine for Team Flare.
Essentia returns to have her Expansion Suit upgraded.
manages to get the captured Vaniville Town residents freed with the help of a wild .
, , , and continue looking for and they find a passerby Rhyhorn racer that Y has left Yvette in the care of.
Y follows Celosia and Malva to where Xerneas is resting.
Celosia and Malva part ways to begin their plans.
Y reunites with X and the others.
Grace frees all the Vaniville residents, only for Celosia to arrive as they are leaving.
Celosia possesses the Vaniville residents with her and begins the operation to move Xerneas.
